When the extraction of an
attribute is done on a horizon,
choosing the right time gate
is critical. The time gate
represents the interval of
investigation. If a
symmetrical time gate is
chosen (e.g. [-28, +28ms])
the attribute will highlight
geological features above
and below the horizon. When
an asymmetrical time gate is
chosen (e.g. [-8, 24ms] or
[-24, 8ms]) the attribute
response will highlight
geological features below or
above the horizon.
